app.title: MulticaBoard - Online Teaching Whiteboard
app.description: Online teaching whiteboard with equation plotting: draw, export, and sync across devices
app.ogImageAlt: MulticaBoard teaching whiteboard — write equations, get vector plots

confirm.discardBody: Creating a new whiteboard will discard your unsaved changes. This cannot be undone.

menu.autosavedTip: Content is autosaved locally; recoverable after refresh or crash

textOverlay.hint: Enter to confirm · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to cancel

canvas.equationHint: Type an equation in the panel on the right and press Enter to insert the graph

equation.title: Equation
equation.kindParabola: Parabola (quadratic in two variables, incl. rotated xy forms)
equation.kindHyperbola: Hyperbola (quadratic in two variables, incl. rotated xy forms)
equation.tplCosineTransform: Cosine form y=A·cos(ωx+φ) (sliders A, ω, φ)
equation.hint: Confirming creates a math plot element on the canvas, with its own coordinate system — move / resize / undo supported.
equation.sliderHint: Missing constant values? Create sliders in one click:

params.title: Math plot
params.eqErrorSuffix: (previous equation kept — fix it and submit again)
params.uniqueSolution: Unique solution: {sol} (marked as a small dot)
params.rotationStd: Rotation θ = {r} (standard form in rotated coordinates X'Y')
params.rotationHyperbola: Rotation θ = {r} (X' is the transverse axis; standard form in rotated coordinates X'Y')
params.rotationEllipse: Rotation θ = {r} (X' is the rx axis; standard form in rotated coordinates X'Y')
params.circleNote: Geometric equations are plotted exactly by parametrization, with automatic equal aspect ratio (1:1).
params.hint: Parameter changes redraw instantly; move / resize / delete can be undone with Ctrl+Z.

advFormula.entryTitle: Dedicated panel for calculus and physics formulas (constants, parametric, f′ overlays, physics templates)
advFormula.title: Advanced formulas
advFormula.dragHint: Drag the title bar to move the panel
advFormula.hint: Calculus and physics capabilities are rolling out step by step, without affecting the basic equation panel.
advFormula.sectionCalculusDesc: f′ overlay, tangent at x₀, integral bounds a/b, ×10 limit zoom
advFormula.sectionConicDesc: Focus / directrix / asymptote annotations (ellipse, hyperbola, parabola)
advFormula.conicNotApplicable: Annotations apply only to ellipse, hyperbola, or parabola equations — a circle’s foci coincide at its center; lines and explicit functions have none.
advFormula.sectionConstantsDesc: v₀ / θ / ω / A / φ constant dictionary editing
advFormula.sectionParametricDesc: x=f(t), y=g(t) and r=f(θ) inputs with t/θ domain
advFormula.constantsEmpty: No constants bound yet — tap a preset symbol to add one, or add a custom one below
advFormula.constantsInvalidName: A constant symbol must start with a letter and contain only letters/digits (x/y/e/π reserved, no duplicates)
advFormula.calcNotApplicable: Calculus overlays apply to explicit functions y=f(x) only — the current equation is not one
advFormula.calcIntegralRange: The integral interval needs a<b and must stay within the domain
advFormula.calcLimitZoomAria: Zoom in ×10: narrow the domain tenfold around the center
advFormula.parametricInactive: Current equation is not parametric / polar — pick a template above, or type x=f(t),y=g(t) / r=f(θ)
advFormula.paramDomainOrder: Range needs lower bound less than upper bound
advFormula.pointsPickAria: Constant bound to the on-curve point
advFormula.pointsFreeXAria: Constant bound to free point x
advFormula.pointsFreeYAria: Constant bound to free point y

phys.marksDesc: Landing & peak marks (range R, height H)
phys.marksNotApplicable: Marks apply to parametric trajectories (x=f(t),y=g(t)) only; simple harmonic motion renders via the regular curve pipeline.

math.ellipseFociCircle: {point} (rx = ry: foci coincide at the center — a circle)
math.lpCoincidentDetail: Discriminant is 0: both roots coincide on the same line
math.degenerateAlwaysTrue: The equation is an identity (0=0 after simplification); it represents no curve
math.degenerateAlwaysFalse: The equation is never true (the two sides differ after simplification); no graph
math.emptyVar: Empty set: the discriminant of the quadratic in {v} is negative — no real roots, no graph in the real plane (e.g. {v}²=−4)
math.emptyEllipse: Empty set: the left side is always positive (or negative) and can never equal 0 — no graph in the real plane (e.g. x²+y²=−1)
math.emptyRotatedVar: Empty set: the discriminant of the quadratic in rotated coordinate u is negative — no real roots, no graph in the real plane

mathErr.generic: Unrecognized expression — check the input format (e.g. y=sin(x))
mathErr.badCharSuffix: — only digits, letters and + − × ÷ ^ ( ) are supported
mathErr.unknownFn: Unknown function "{name}" — supported: sin, cos, tan, sec, csc, cot, sqrt, abs, log, exp, asin, acos, atan, floor, ceil, round, sign, mod, min, max
mathErr.arity: Wrong number of function arguments — check inside the parentheses (e.g. sin(x), log(8,2))
mathErr.parenUnclosed: Unclosed parenthesis or absolute value bars — close them, e.g. y=sin(x)
mathErr.piecewiseUnclosed: Piecewise is missing the closing brace “}” — add “}” to finish it (e.g. y={x<0:-x; x})
mathErr.piecewiseBranchIncomplete: Segment {n} is incomplete — each segment must be “condition:expression” (e.g. x<0:-x); the unconditional default may only be the last segment
mathErr.piecewiseCondInvalid: The condition of segment {n} is not recognized — write it like x<0, x≥0 or 0≤x<2 (“=” is not supported as a condition)
mathErr.piecewiseEmptyInterval: The condition interval of segment {n} is contradictory (e.g. 2<x<1) — the left bound must not exceed the right bound
mathErr.piecewiseValueFirst: Segment {n} seems to put the value before the condition — write each segment as “condition:value” (e.g. y={x<0:-x; x})
mathErr.incomplete: Incomplete expression — finish the formula, e.g. y=2x+1
mathErr.badNumber: Invalid number format — check the notation, e.g. 1.5
mathErr.oneEquals: An equation can contain only one equals sign
mathErr.missingEquals: Missing equals sign: enter y=f(x) or a linear equation in two variables (e.g. 3x+2y=6)
mathErr.missingRhs: Missing right-hand side — use the form y=f(x), e.g. y=2x+1
mathErr.badSymbolImplicit: Unrecognized symbol "{name}" — check the spelling; use a single letter as the variable (e.g. z=4x)
mathErr.badSymbolExplicit: Unrecognized symbol "{name}" — check the spelling; use a single letter as the variable (e.g. y=2z)
mathErr.tooManyVarsImplicit: A two-variable equation allows at most two letters (found {list}) — simplify and retry
mathErr.multiVarExplicit: The equation contains multiple independent variables ({list}) — keep a single letter as the variable (e.g. y=2x)
mathErr.multiVarWithConstants: The equation still has unassigned symbols ({list}) — assign values in the constants section of the advanced formula panel, or keep a single letter as the variable
mathErr.unsupportedImplicit: This implicit equation is not supported yet: supported are y=f(x), circle/ellipse standard and general forms, linear equations in two variables, and quadratic equations in two variables (parabola / hyperbola / rotated conics with an xy term / degenerate line pairs and single points, e.g. y²=4x, xy=1, 5x²−6xy+5y²=8, x²−y²=0)
mathErr.domainOrder: Invalid domain: xmin must be less than xmax
mathErr.domainWidth: Invalid domain: width must be between 0.1 and 1000
mathErr.noValidValues: No valid values in the domain — adjust the domain or check the expression (e.g. y=√x needs x≥0)
mathErr.notALine: The equation does not represent a line
mathErr.notAParabola: The equation does not represent a parabola
mathErr.notAHyperbola: The equation does not represent a hyperbola
mathErr.invalidDomainOrder: Invalid domain: xMin must be less than xMax
mathErr.invalidDomainWidth: Invalid domain: width must be between 0.1 and 1000
mathErr.integralInvalid: Invalid integral interval (a must be less than b) — adjust the a/b endpoints
mathErr.integralSingularity: The function is undefined somewhere in the interval — adjust a/b to avoid it (e.g. 1/x must avoid x=0)
mathErr.parametricNoParameter: Neither side of the parametric form has a parameter letter — introduce one, e.g. x=cos(t),y=sin(t)

autosave.conflict: Another tab is also editing this whiteboard; this tab's latest content was saved
